summary.whatChanges: V8 coverage now wraps the URL-to-file-path conversion in a try/catch and skips coverage entries whose URL can't be converted (e.g. virtual modules like `/@fs/virtual:...`) instead of throwing. Test fixtures add a third virtual file case, and the virtual-files coverage test is excluded from two test projects.
behaviorChanges: Coverage runs no longer crash when V8 reports a script URL that isn't a valid file URL; such entries are silently omitted from the report.
Virtual modules resolved to non-file-like ids are excluded from the V8 coverage report rather than causing an error.
The virtual-files coverage test now runs with injectCjsGlobals disabled and is skipped in two of the test projects.
risks: The catch block swallows all conversion errors with no warning, so genuinely malformed-but-real files would drop out of coverage silently and be hard to diagnose.
Excluding the virtual-files test from two project configurations reduces coverage of this fix in those environments.
